meta.name: abp-authorization
meta.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4/10.5) authorization: defining permissions (PermissionDefinitionProvider), [Authorize], CheckPolicyAsync/IsGrantedAsync, CurrentUser, IPermissionManager, resource-based auth, multi-tenancy permissions. Use when you need permission, role or access checks in ABP.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在开发基于 ABP 框架的应用并需要实现授权机制。
copy.tagline_en: Control user permissions and role access in ABP applications
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing ABP applications and need to implement authorization.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能指导你在ABP项目中定义权限、进行授权检查、获取当前用户信息等。
howto.when: 当用户询问关于权限、授权、角色、策略、资源授权或ABP访问控制时触发。

say.text: 检查用户是否有某权限？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you in defining permissions, performing authorization checks, and accessing current user information in ABP projects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about permissions, authorization, roles, policies, resource-based authorization, or access control in ABP Framework.

say_en.text: How to define permissions in ABP?
say_en.note: Claude will show you how to create a PermissionDefinitionProvider class.

say_en.text: Check if a user has a permission?
say_en.note: Claude will demonstrate CheckPolicyAsync or IsGrantedAsync usage.
Claude will show how to get user ID, roles, etc.
